description: Porti e impianti nautici is a dataset listed in Italian Catalogue of metadata for Spatial Data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by srvcarto.regione.liguria.it. The areas were acquired initially in collaboration with the University of Genoa Dip.Ter.Is through restitution for photointerpretation of coastal flight n. 64 of 2003. In the case of extensions and new designs, the data was acquired from the projects provided by the individual designers. Coverage: IT. The portal shows the English title as "Ports and nautical installations" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include TRASPORTO, open data, CARTE TEMATICHE. The listing shows 3 download or service links in WFS, WMS. The listing shows 2022-01-01 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-rndt.
